name: wildcore
description: WildCore DMS MCP server (devices, interfaces, ONUs, optical signals, switcher-core, macros, ONU registration) with operating skills

wildcore_token.title: WildCore API key
wildcore_token.description: API key (X-Auth-Key) of the WildCore user the tools run as. Use a dedicated user with only the permissions you want to give Claude.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide tools that change equipment or WildCore data (macros execution, ONU registration, switcher-core control).

docker_image.title: Docker image
docker_image.description: wildcore-mcp image to run (published by CI to ghcr.io/wildcore-dms/mcp-server)
